method.label: Turn reciprocals into an arithmetic sequence

annotationRationale: Taking reciprocals transforms the recurrence into constant successive differences, allowing the arithmetic-sequence term formula. Checking lowest terms identifies p and q.
sourceMethod: Followed the official reciprocal-sequence alternative, with the common-difference arithmetic and lowest-terms check made explicit.

review.mathCheck: The reciprocal recurrence gives b_n=2b_{n-1}-b_{n-2}, hence b_n=(4n-1)/3>0. Therefore a_2019=3/8075. Since 8075 is not divisible by 3, p+q=8078, choice E.
review.sourceMethodCheck: Faithful, independently phrased adaptation of official #15's reciprocal alternative on pp.8-9. It preserves the constant-difference argument and adds an explicit coprimality check.
review.annotationCheck: The substitution, arithmetic-sequence deduction, index 2018, and lowest-terms check are explicit and appropriate for AMC 12. No induction argument is required.
